verdict.rationale: Cooley documents some multi-jurisdiction venture capability. Its GO platform offers UK and Singapore versions of the YC Safe generator alongside the US one, and the firm cites 19 international offices across Asia and Europe and a #1 global ranking for representing companies raising venture capital. However, nothing in the evidence addresses flips or redomiciliations, or work representing international investors. missing for 10: documented flip/redomiciliation practice, explicit cross-border or international-investor financing documentation, multi-jurisdiction deal examples, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings
